title: react-vite template UI manifest
description: Declares where UI building blocks live in scenarios generated from the react-vite template. Consumed by react-component-library's adoption resolver to compute canonical filesystem paths for adopted components.

designTokens.description: Generated: templates/design/_base/tokens.css plus the selected kit's adapter overlay. Carries the /* rcl:tokens:begin */ … /* rcl:tokens:end */ managed region that react-component-library tokens-sync owns.

tailwindTheme.description: Generated from the selected kit's adapter; mirrors design-tokens.css for Tailwind.

tokenMap.description: Scenario-owned translation of the library's app-* Tailwind roles into this scenario's CSS variables, with the contrast floor.

localeCatalogue.description: i18next catalogues, one per supported locale; react-component-library merges library strings into each.

selectorRegistry.description: Typed selector registry; the generated selectors.manifest.json beside it is derived by `pnpm selector:manifest`.

librarySelectors.description: Written by react-component-library adoptions link; imported by selectors.ts inside the vrooli:library-selectors markers.

appEntry.description: Mount point; react-component-library adoptions link installs its strings provider here inside the vrooli:library-strings-provider markers.

stringsRegistry.description: Generated by `pnpm strings:gen` from the default locale catalogue.

contract.extensionRule: Scenarios may override individual slot `dir` values inside their own .vrooli/ui-manifest.json overlay. New slot names must be added to the template manifest, not the overlay.

ui-primitive.description: Scenario-local headless primitives. Empty by design: primitives come from react-component-library as linked imports. Kebab-case filenames when one is genuinely scenario-specific.

shared-component.description: Cross-cutting components used by multiple features or layouts (e.g. ErrorBoundary).

ui-component.description: Compatibility alias for shared UI components in the catalog vocabulary.

layout-shell.description: Shell configuration. `AppShell.tsx` mounts the component library's AppShell with this scenario's nav items and router adapter; it does not draw chrome. Shares the layout dir with layout-nav by design.

layout-nav.description: Navigation data and the scenario's mark (navItems.tsx, BrandMark.tsx). The library shell renders both presentations from the one item list. Shares the layout dir with layout-shell by design.

page.description: Routed pages mounted under the shell's Outlet.

feature.description: Feature folder. Owns its own components, hooks, API client wrapper, and tests.

feature-component.description: A single component inside a feature folder.

api-client.description: Connect-RPC client modules and small API wrappers.

i18n-strings.description: i18next catalog JSON files. One per locale.

theme-token.description: ThemeProvider (light / dark / system, writes data-theme and data-resolved-theme). Design tokens themselves live in the generated ui/src/design-tokens.css declared under `files.designTokens`, not here.
